decisions.reason: Full-page sizing applies specifically to chapter illustrations; it does not change the interior trim size, publication format, or general layout requirement.
Chapter-image sizing does not alter the hierarchy, capitalization, or formatting of chapter headings.
Formatting chapter images as full-page does not change the requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after finalizing the book size.
The chapter-image size decision does not modify the copyright page's publisher line or layout.
The decision concerns chapter illustrations and does not resolve whether the interior title page should contain an image.
Full-page chapter-image formatting has no effect on the prohibition against a literal newline artifact in the book title.
Chapter illustrations are distinct from the paperback cover; the source decision changes neither cover content nor cover dimensions.
The size of chapter illustrations does not change the required back matter or author copy.
Formatting chapter images as full-page does not change manuscript wording, editing goals, or approved passages.
